title: Icons
slide_intent: Select both icon family and file format by use because print, screen and navigation impose different production needs.
strategic_value: Separate download routes can help Helsinki retain recognizable icons without mixing their functional roles.
demonstration: This webpage component groups signage, illustration and HDS user-interface icon sources, naming SVG/PDF vector originals for print and PNG for screen where specified.
practical_value: Choose the functional icon family first, then retrieve a file suitable for the output medium.

content_islands.name: Signage icons
content_islands.spec: Place the building/park uses and SVG/PDF-print versus PNG-screen guidance with the signage download.

content_islands.name: Illustration icons
content_islands.spec: Follow with communication examples and PDF-print versus PNG-screen guidance.

content_islands.name: UI icons
content_islands.spec: End with the Helsinki Design System download route.

ingredient.name: Icon assets
ingredient.role: Provide suitable symbols for signage, illustration or interfaces.
ingredient.application: Choose signage SVG/PDF or illustration PDF for print, and PNG for screen; use HDS for UI icons.
ingredient.scope: Format recommendations are stated for signage and illustration downloads; this component does not show icon artwork.

reference_purposes.Application: The source maps signage and illustration icons to uses and formats and routes UI icons to HDS.
